Only the requested game runs at this skin; artwork does not change ROM/core or seat count.

Plain off-white sides and edging follow the supplied conversion cabinet. Its exact manufacturer/region and opposite-side condition are unverified. The front/bezel stay black; the existing original-design marquee and blue panel are retained rather than replacing them with the differently photographed kit.
The photographed single station has duplicated left/right Speed/Jump pairs plus two Start buttons, six physical buttons; two sequential players share that station.
